    \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/button/index.md">Buttons</a>|
    \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/tabs/index.md">Tabs</a>|

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/menu/menu.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-menu");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("ul");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element3 = document.createElement("li");

const element4 = document.createElement("a");
element4.setAttribute("href", "/#/components/button/index.md");
element4.append(document.createTextNode("Buttons"));
element3.append(element4);
element2.append(element3);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element5 = document.createElement("li");

const element6 = document.createElement("a");
element6.setAttribute("href", "/#/components/tabs/index.md");
element6.append(document.createTextNode("Tabs"));
element5.append(element6);
element2.append(element5);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element7 = document.createElement("li");

const element8 = document.createElement("a");
element8.setAttribute("href", "/#/components/tree/index.md");
element8.append(document.createTextNode("Trees"));
element7.append(element8);
element2.append(element7);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);
example.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));

const element9 = document.createElement("script");
element9.setAttribute("src", "/docs/components/menu/examples/navigation.js");
example.append(element9);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Nested submenus
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Open Components, then Layout, then Rows to explore three submenu levels. Click a branch to open it, or focus Components and press Arrow Down, then Arrow Right twice. Arrow Left closes a submenu and returns focus to its parent. Links open the corresponding documentation page.


\wcTpBox[style=min-height: 22rem]{
  \wcTpMenu[orientation=horizontal]{
    \begin{itemize}
      \item Components      \begin{itemize}
        \item Layout        \begin{itemize}
          \item Rows          \begin{itemize}
            \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/inline/index.md">Inline</a>|
            \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/cluster/index.md">Cluster</a>|
          \end{itemize}
          \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/grid/index.md">Grid</a>|
          \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/frame/index.md">Frame</a>|
        \end{itemize}
        \item Navigation        \begin{itemize}
          \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/tabs/index.md">Tabs</a>|
          \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/tree/index.md">Trees</a>|
        \end{itemize}
      \end{itemize}
      \item \rawhtml*|<a href="/#/components/button/index.md">Buttons</a>|
    \end{itemize}
  }
}

\wcScript[src=/docs/components/menu/examples/navigation.js]||
\end{document}
